# Exercise debrief: sensorsoff-hard-exposed

## Outcome
Exercise over: the intruder read the protected file on ember.

Detection delay: none recorded.
Containment move: isolated ember (evt-0023).

## Timeline
- **First probe** (evt-0002): The intruder asked zephyr for /admin/health (evt-0002).
- **First look** (evt-0003): The defender checked logs on juniper (evt-0003).
- **First sign-in** (evt-0004): The intruder signed in to ember as steward (evt-0004).
- **Protected file read** (evt-0012): The intruder read the protected file on ember (evt-0012).
- **Containment** (evt-0023): The defender isolated ember (evt-0023). That came 19 moves after the sign-in (evt-0004 to evt-0023).
- **No detection** (evt-0024): The defender never reported the intrusion through evt-0024.

## What the defender did well
- The defender checked host logs before acting. (evt-0003, evt-0023)
- The defender attached log evidence to a report. (evt-0023)

## Weaknesses and recommendations
- The intruder read the protected file on ember. (evt-0004, evt-0012)
  Recommendation: Contain the signed-in host before the intruder reaches the protected file.
- The defender never reported the intrusion. (evt-0002, evt-0024)
  Recommendation: Report findings as soon as logs or alerts look wrong.
- Containment came 19 moves after the sign-in. (evt-0004, evt-0023)
  Recommendation: Contain the signed-in host on the next defender turn.
- A guessed password opened ember as steward. (evt-0004)
  Recommendation: Rotate the ember password and slow repeated bad guesses.

_Layer 1 report, derived from the exercise log with no model. All event ids cite the exercise log._
